verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions official client SDKs or libraries for any language. It documents a raw REST API with bearer-token auth and curl examples, a Terraform integration and an MCP server. These are developer building blocks or different integration surfaces, not official SDKs, so they earn no credit. The OpenAPI probes also returned 404, so there is no spec to generate clients from.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
